nodes.label: StackedBars

nodes.label: ClientMeetingsPage
nodes.note: /meetings/client` - sessions of kind `CLIENT` (real meetings), with status filter and PDF download for closed ones.

nodes.label: ClientOverviewPage
nodes.note: /clients/:clientId` - client info panel plus one card per product group.

nodes.label: ClientSearchPage
nodes.note: /clients` - search box backed by the client registry; results link to the overview page.

nodes.label: fe-app
nodes.note: app shell: routing, layouts, providers, channel modules

nodes.label: ImportsPage
nodes.note: /admin/imports` - monitor of the daily XLS movement imports with a manual trigger.

nodes.label: ParametersPage
nodes.note: /admin/parameters` - parameter sets with product group filter and inline editing.

nodes.label: PreparationSessionsPage
nodes.note: /meetings/preparation` - sessions of kind `PREPARATION` (dry runs by the representative), same list and actions.

nodes.label: PresentationPage
nodes.note: /present/:sessionId` - what the client sees on the second screen.

nodes.label: Product1OverviewPage
nodes.note: /session/:sessionId/product1` - first meeting step for Product 1: city filter, the four projection tables, cover ratio chart, cover quote panel and the two input modals.

nodes.label: Product2OverviewPage
nodes.note: /session/:sessionId/product2` - first meeting step for Product 2: transport mode filter, the four projection tables, cover ratio chart, cover quote panel and the two input modals.

nodes.label: ScenariosPage
nodes.note: /session/:sessionId/scenarios` - second meeting step: list of scenarios of the session, baseline curve info and the editor to add / change / remove scenarios.

nodes.label: SessionSummaryPage
nodes.note: /session/:sessionId/summary` - last meeting step: role override, close the session, preview the report payload and download the rendered PDF.

nodes.label: StressTestPage
nodes.note: /session/:sessionId/stress-test` - third meeting step: one monthly table per scenario, transport price chart per scenario and the dimension toggle (city / transport mode).

nodes.label: baseline_price
nodes.note: Baseline price and transport price per product group, corridor and month, as loaded from market data. (7 columns)

nodes.label: client_profile
nodes.note: A client of the platform: master data merged from the client registry, one row per external reference. (6 columns)

nodes.label: client_role
nodes.note: Role of a client per product group (IMPORTER, EXPORTER, MIXED, UNDETERMINED) as decided from its movements or overridden in a session. (7 columns)

nodes.label: cover_policy
nodes.note: Cover policies of a client per product group and sub-product: covered share, premium rate, validity. (8 columns)

nodes.label: cover_quote
nodes.note: Quote requested from the cover provider for the uncovered value of a session. (6 columns)

nodes.label: goods_movement
nodes.note: Daily movements as imported from the file exchange, one row per line of the file after validation. (12 columns)

nodes.label: import_batch
nodes.note: One received movement file: its status and row counts. (6 columns)

nodes.label: market_scenario
nodes.note: Market scenario defined in a session: named shocks on prices and transport prices used by the stress test. (7 columns)

nodes.label: meeting_report
nodes.note: The meeting report of a closed session: payload sent for rendering, PDF path and rendering status. (5 columns)

nodes.label: meeting_session
nodes.note: A meeting with a client (CLIENT) or a preparation dry run (PREPARATION) for one product group; every session-scoped table hangs off it. (12 columns)

nodes.label: movement_monthly
nodes.note: Monthly aggregate of goods_movement per client, sub-product, city, transport mode and direction; the input of every projection. (10 columns)

nodes.label: parameter_set
nodes.note: Admin parameters: one value per key and scope (product group, country, value), valid from a date. (9 columns)

nodes.label: projection_by_dimension
nodes.note: Monthly projection per dimension value: city for Product 1, transport mode for Product 2 (dimension_kind says which). (9 columns)

nodes.label: projection_by_direction
nodes.note: Monthly projection per direction (IN, OUT). (8 columns)

nodes.label: projection_by_subproduct
nodes.note: Monthly projection table per sub-product of the session (cumulative values over the horizon). (8 columns)

nodes.label: projection_summary
nodes.note: Monthly totals of the session projection with the cover ratio. (8 columns)

nodes.label: session_client_config
nodes.note: Per-session choices of the client: projection horizon, price basis and cover preference. (4 columns)

nodes.label: session_movement_input
nodes.note: Movements modelled by hand during a session (the movement modal); they replace the imported history for the months they cover. (9 columns)

nodes.label: session_peer_simulation
nodes.note: Peer simulation requested in a session: the peer segment and the scaling factor applied to the projection of the client. (5 columns)

nodes.label: shedlock
nodes.note: ShedLock table: distributed locks of the scheduled jobs (one row per job name). Technical. (4 columns)

nodes.label: stress_test_result
nodes.note: Stress test output per session, scenario, month and dimension value: exposure and cumulative exposure. (8 columns)
